en-US.description: The Visual Controls software supports design and specification with Acuity Controls. You can quickly determine device quantities for a budgetary bid and generate a comprehensive professional submittal.
en-US.longDescription:
The Visual Controls software supports design and specification with Acuity Controls. You can quickly determine device quantities for a budgetary bid and generate a comprehensive professional submittal.
- Import PDF/DWG or background images
- Decrease design time importing from Visual Lighting software
- Searchable product database with quick access to Acuity products
- Intelligent wire connections between devices
- Automate SOO generation based on devices in the room
- Automate Riser generation based on your design
- Reduce errors with design auditing
- Work with multiple designs in one project file
- Customize output to your design requirements
en-US.name: Visual Controls

zh-CN.description: Visual Controls 软件支持使用 Acuity Controls 进行设计和规范制定。您可以快速确定初步投标所需的设备数量，并生成全面且专业的提交文件。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Visual Controls 软件支持使用 Acuity Controls 进行设计和规范制定。您可以快速确定初步投标所需的设备数量，并生成全面且专业的提交文件。
- 导入 PDF/DWG 或背景图像
- 通过从 Visual Lighting 软件导入来缩短设计时间
- 可搜索的产品数据库，快速获取 Acuity 产品
- 设备间智能布线连接
- 根据空间内的设备自动生成控制逻辑说明 (SOO)
- 根据您的设计自动生成系统立面图 (Riser)
- 通过设计审核减少错误
- 在一个项目文件中处理多个设计方案
- 根据您的设计要求定制输出内容
